hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: Bonding-curve token launch hook for a pump-style platform. Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe rule, a permanent 2% wallet buy cap with auto-refund, and a 1% trading fee (70% creator / 30% platform) with a decaying anti-snipe premium on buys. Graduates pools from the bonding curve to open liquidity once the curve completes, then passes swaps through unchanged.
